brief:
Israeli forces and illegal settlers escalated attacks across the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem on Sunday, leaving four Palestinians injured, IMEMC News reported. The incidents occurred as tensions continued to rise in the territory.

Details of the specific locations and circumstances of the injuries were not immediately available. The escalation follows a pattern of heightened violence in recent weeks across occupied Palestinian territories.
dek: Israeli forces and illegal Israeli colonizers escalated their attacks across the occupied West Bank, including occupied Jerusalem, on Sunday.
title: Israeli forces and settlers injure four Palestinians in West Bank escalation
